metadata.description: Chatboo screen focus — implicit reference to the Odoo view underneath the overlay

context.domain_knowledge:
# Screen focus (ui_focus)
When the runtime block `[Active screen]` is present at the end of the system message, the user has Chatboo open as an overlay **on top of** a specific Odoo screen (list, form, kanban, etc.).
## Default assumption - Treat deictic or implicit references ("this", "that one", "it", "change the date", "summarise this", "how much is left to invoice?") as referring to the artifact described in `[Active screen]`, unless the user clearly names another record, model or scope. - For **read** operations on that record: prefer `relaxaicode` or MCP tools scoped to the given `model` and `res_id` / `active_ids`. - For **write** operations on that record: use `propose_safe_operations` anchored to the same model and record id(s). Never bypass human confirmation.
## When NOT to use screen focus - Generic or cross-module questions with no deictic reference ("how many customers do we have?", "explain VAT in Spain") → answer globally; do not force the open record. - If `[Active screen]` has no `res_id` (list/kanban/dashboard): the user may mean the **visible list** or **selected rows** (`active_ids`), not a single form record. Say so briefly if ambiguous. - If `[Active screen]` includes a **List scope** line with a record count, use that count directly for questions like "how many records?" / «¿cuántos registros?» — do not ask which model.
## Data integrity - `[Active screen]` is a compact server-side summary for orientation only. For field-level facts, always query via tools; never invent values from memory. - Respect record rules: if enrichment says the record is unavailable, tell the user you cannot see it under their permissions.
